newsitem.title: USA: Levi Strauss Q1 sales reach $1.6 bln.
newsitem.headline: Levi Strauss Q1 sales reach $1.6 bln.

text.p: Levi Strauss & Co on Thursday said its first quarter sales reached $1.6 billion, up one percent from the year-ago quarter.

The apparel maker said sales in the United States were $898.8 million, also an increase of one percent from the first quarter of 1996. U.S. sales were led by the Levi's Dockers brand of men's clothes and Slates dress pants for men.

Outside the U.S., total sales for the first quarter were $691.2 million, again a one percent hike from last year. The increase was driven by a favorable sales mix of Levi's 501 jeans and related products in Europe.
European sales were slightly offset by lower revenue in the Asia Pacific region, due chiefly to business conditions in Japan and South Korea, including weaker local currencies, it said.
